text: Go, and repent of it. Don’t add new injuries to the long, long list of injuries you have done me!’ ‘Aye!’ he returned. ‘It’s all very fine--Well! I must do the best I can, for the present, I suppose.’ In spite of himself, he appeared abashed by my aunt’s indignant tears, and came slouching out of the garden. Taking two or three quick steps, as if I had just come up, I met him at the gate, and went in as he came out.
